local_changes: lfs.c: a write inside a file copies the original tail through a 512-byte buffer (lfs_file_copyorig) rather than a byte at a time, and a forward seek while writing, within what the file held, copies only up to the new position and goes on writing, so ascending writes copy the tail once, at the flush. lfs_bd_cmp and lfs_bd_crc read 512 bytes at a time rather than 8. Checked against a file model with random seeks, writes, reads, truncates, syncs, reopens and remounts.
